sections.text: Last week, Maria went to a government office to get a new identity card. She had to fill in a long form with her personal information. First, she wrote her name and surname, and then her birthplace. Maria was born in a small town, but now she lives in the city, so she also wrote her new address. The form asked about her nationality and her occupation — she works as a nurse. Maria is married, not single, so she wrote her husband's name too. After that, she needed to sign the document. Her signature had to look exactly like the one on her passport. The clerk checked her identity card and passport together. He also asked for her phone number and email address, in case the office needed to write to her later. Finally, he said that a new card for a male or female applicant usually takes two weeks. Maria left the office and hoped her new card would arrive soon.

sections.text: Last month, two new colleagues joined our office, Tom and Lucy. Their appearance and personality are very different. sections.text: On Sunday, I decided to try a new recipe I found online. First, I checked I had all the ingredients: chicken, rice, vegetables, and some spices. I began by chopping an onion and a few vegetables into small pieces. Then I had to slice a ripe tomato and mix it with the other ingredients in a big pot. The recipe said to fry the chicken first, then boil it with rice for twenty minutes. For dessert, I decided to bake a cake instead of buying one. While the cake was in the oven, I roasted some potatoes as a side dish. When everything was ready, I had to taste the food before serving it — it was a little too spicy for me, so I added some sugar to balance the sour and sweet flavors. The final meal was absolutely delicious! I made too much food, so I had a lot of leftovers for the next day. I gave my neighbor a portion too, and she loved it. First, she went online to browse different shops and compare prices before leaving home. At the store, there was a big sale, so many items had a discount. The customer service worker gave her a receipt and said that if the jacket didn't fit, she could bring it back for an exchange or a refund. A week later, she realized the jacket was the wrong size, so she returned it to the store with her receipt. The staff were friendly and gave her money back immediately. sections.text: Last weekend, the weather changed very quickly in our town. On Saturday morning, the sky was clear and sunny, so my family decided to go for a walk by the lake. The sun felt warm on our faces, and the temperature was about twenty-five degrees. But in the afternoon, dark clouds appeared and the sky became very cloudy. The forecast on the radio said a storm was coming, so we hurried home. Soon the wind grew strong and it became windy outside. We heard thunder in the distance, and then the rain started. It was a very rainy evening! We stayed inside, warm and dry, and watched from the window. My little brother was worried because the streets began to fill with water, almost like a flood. sections.text: Wildlife around the world faces many problems today. Many species of animals are losing their natural habitat because people are cutting down forests and building cities. Some animals, like certain mammals and birds, are now endangered, which means there are very few of them left in the wild. If we do not protect them, they could become extinct, like the dinosaurs many years ago. Zoos try to help. In many zoos, workers breed endangered animals so that more babies are born and the species can survive. For example, a bird might build a nest in the zoo, just like it would in the wild. However, many people believe that a cage is not a real home, and wild animals are happier in nature. In the wild, predators hunt other animals, called prey, to find food. Some animals, like certain birds, migrate to warmer places every winter to survive the cold weather. Every animal, from a small insect to a large mammal with thick fur, has an important place in nature. We must work together to protect wildlife and their habitats for the future.

sections.text: Every country has its own culture, and culture includes many things: language, food, music, and tradition. Traditions are customs that pass from one generation to the next, often starting with our ancestors many years ago. For example, in some cultures, people wear a special costume for a wedding or another important ceremony. Families celebrate these events together, and everyone shows respect for the older members, called elders, who often teach the younger generation about their history and beliefs. In many places, religion also plays a big part in local traditions and ceremonies. Music and dance are important too. Folk music and traditional dances tell stories about the past and are often performed during festivals and celebrations. Many symbols, like special colors or animals, also have deep meaning in a culture. These symbols help people remember their heritage and values. Learning about different cultures and their traditions helps us understand and respect people from other countries. Even though customs are different around the world, most cultures value family, respect, and celebration in similar ways.

sections.text: Festivals happen in every country around the world, and each one is special. During a festival, people often gather in the streets to watch a parade with music, dancing, and colorful costumes. Some festivals also have fireworks that light up the sky at night, and everyone in the crowd looks up with joy. Before a big festival, families often put up decorations at home, like lights or paper lanterns. Sometimes people light candles too. Many festivals are also national holidays, so people do not have to work and can spend the whole day celebrating with family. Guests are often invited to a big feast, where everyone eats together and shares gifts. In some countries, people wear masks and dance to the sound of drums during the festival. Every year, thousands of tourists attend famous festivals just to see the amazing parades and decorations. Even though festivals are different in every country, they all bring people together and create a feeling of joy and community. Festivals help us remember our culture and enjoy time with the people we love.

sections.text: Emotions are a big part of our lives. Every day, we feel happy, sad, angry, or excited about different things. Sometimes we feel afraid or nervous before something new, like a job interview or a wedding. Our family and friends help us understand our emotions. A good relationship is built on trust and love. When you trust someone, you believe they will not hurt you. Friends and family also share their problems with each other, and they support one another when life is hard. Sometimes people argue with someone they love, but a strong relationship can survive an argument if both people forgive each other. It is important to care about how other people feel. If a friend feels sad or lonely, you can comfort them and listen carefully. Many people want a happy marriage, but every relationship needs work. You have to talk, listen, and understand your partner's feelings. When you show that you care and support the people around you, your relationships become stronger. Good emotional health means you can feel your emotions, talk about them, and ask for help when you need it.

sections.text: Good time management helps you get more done every day. First, make a plan for your day or week. You can write your tasks on a calendar or use an app to organize your schedule. It is helpful to choose your priority, which means the most important task first. If something is urgent, do it quickly. A deadline is the time when a task must be finished, so try not to delay your work. Some people are always punctual, which means they arrive on time or a little early, but other people are often late. Setting a reminder can help you remember an important appointment or task. It is good to have a daily routine, like waking up, eating, and working at the same time every day. A routine helps you focus and manage your time better. When you plan well, you can achieve your goals faster. However, it is also important to find a balance between work and rest. If you work all the time without resting, you will become tired. Good time management is not about doing everything, but about doing the right things at the right time.

sections.text: Many people like to volunteer in their free time. To volunteer means to help other people without getting paid. There are many ways to help your community. You can donate old clothes, food, or money to a charity. A charity is an organization that helps people in need. Some charities help homeless people find a warm shelter and food to eat. Other groups help needy families or sick children. If you want to help, you can also fundraise, which means you collect money for a good cause. Volunteering takes effort, but it is a kind thing to do. When people work together, teamwork makes the job easier and more fun. You don't have to give a lot of money to be generous; you can also assist your neighbor by helping them carry bags or clean their garden. Every small contribution helps. Small acts of kindness can help someone feel better. Many people encourage their friends and family to volunteer too, because everyone can benefit from helping others. When you help someone, they often feel thankful, and you feel good too. Volunteering makes communities stronger and kinder places to live.

sections.text: Everyone has dreams about the future. Some people want a good career, some want to travel, and some want to start a family. To reach your goal, you need a clear plan. First, decide what you really want in life, then think about the steps you need to take. Many people make a resolution at the start of a new year, like learning a new skill or getting a better job. It is normal to face a challenge on your journey to success. When things get difficult, try to stay confident and keep going. You can ask a friend or teacher to motivate you when you feel tired. Every mistake is also an opportunity to improve and learn something new. If you aim high and work hard, you can achieve your goals and succeed in life. It helps to imagine your future clearly: where do you want to be in five years? Having hope for the future gives you energy to keep trying, even when the path is not easy. Your ambition can guide you through hard times. Remember, the future is not fixed; every choice you make today can change your path tomorrow.
